question: Solve for $x$: $\left| \begin{matrix}x & 2 \\ 2 & x \end{matrix} \right| = 9$
explanation:
Compute the determinant.
$\left| \begin{matrix}x & 2 \\ 2 & x \end{matrix} \right| = x \cdot x - 2 \cdot 2$.
So the determinant becomes $x^2 - 4$.
Set the determinant equal to $9$.
$x^2 - 4 = 9$.
$x^2 = 13$.
Taking square root on both sides gives $x = \pm \sqrt{13}$.
